criteria.requirement: Describe JSONStorage write as serialization followed by overwrite/flush/fsync/truncate of the current file, not an atomic temporary-file replace or transaction. Do not invent existing AtomicJSONStorage/export_backup/import_backup or automatic backups.

Prefer a single-writer stop/close consistent backup point, byte/JSON validation, retention of all named tables and document IDs, protected restore to a checked empty/new destination, and synthetic reopen/next-ID rehearsal. Reject malformed/incompatible backups and unrelated nonempty-target overwrite.

Separate current guarantees from proposed future storage work. If discussing atomic replace, identify serialization/temporary-write failure preservation and same-directory/same-filesystem considerations without promising universal crash durability. This is a plan only: do not touch real files or claim an implementation exists.
